title: 鐵路平交道警報聯動
summary: 本課聚焦平交道警示時序道路清空與界面整合。從道路使用者反應距離建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把路口回堵累積與區段偵測有效性連成可驗證的介面，最後以路鐵整合情境矩陣整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies crossing-warning timing road clearance and interface integration. Start with road-user reaction distance to define physical or information boundaries, connect queue spillback toward the crossing with validity of section detection as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through road–rail integration scenario matrix. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 道路使用者反應距離與道路車輛停止距離
stages.titleEn: Road-user reaction distance & Stopping distance of road vehicles
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「道路使用者反應距離」與「道路車輛停止距離」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Road-user reaction distance" and "Stopping distance of road vehicles": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 道路使用者反應距離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Road-user reaction distance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「道路使用者反應距離」如何影響鐵路平交道警報聯動的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Road-user reaction distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway grade-crossing warning coordination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以假想道路接近速度分析察覺到反應的移動距離，保留不同視線與能力群體的差異。反應期間移動距離由速度乘反應時間決定，這段距離在任何制動能力發揮前已經消耗。察覺、理解與動作不是同一時刻，介面可讀性和預期程度會改變反應；把受訓受試者的最佳表現當作所有人的固定值會低估需求。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「道路使用者反應距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use an assumed road-approach speed to analyse travel between detection and response, retaining differences in visibility and user capability. Distance during reaction is speed times reaction time and is consumed before braking can take effect. Detection, interpretation and action are separate moments influenced by readability and expectation. The best performance of a trained participant is not a fixed value applicable to everyone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Road-user reaction distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「制動性能很好就可以完全忽略人員反應期間的距離」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Good braking performance allows reaction distance to be ignored completely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「道路使用者反應距離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Road-user reaction distance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：制動性能很好就可以完全忽略人員反應期間的距離 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Good braking performance allows reaction distance to be ignored completely. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「鐵路平交道警報聯動」的「道路使用者反應距離：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出車輛、軌道、牽引供電、號誌與旅客的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「號誌與供電交班模擬」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與版本一致的速度、時間、位置、負載及控制紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Road-user reaction distance: mechanism and system paths” in “Railway grade-crossing warning coordination”. Draw the vehicle, track, traction, signaling and passenger interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Signalling and supply handover simulation” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for version-aligned speed, time, position, load and control records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「道路使用者反應距離」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Road-user reaction distance" is correct?
options: 制動性能很好就可以完全忽略人員反應期間的距離
本單元以假想道路接近速度分析察覺到反應的移動距離，保留不同視線與能力群體的差異。
速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成
optionsEn: Good braking performance allows reaction distance to be ignored completely.
Use an assumed road-approach speed to analyse travel between detection and response, retaining differences in visibility and user capability.
Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以假想道路接近速度分析察覺到反應的移動距離，保留不同視線與能力群體的差異。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use an assumed road-approach speed to analyse travel between detection and response, retaining differences in visibility and user capability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 道路使用者反應距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Road-user reaction distance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「道路使用者反應距離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Road-user reaction distance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。公式 y=v*reaction，代入得 y=40 m。邊界：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s. Formula y=v*reaction gives y=40 m. Boundary: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以安全桌面重播分別量察覺與動作時間，呈現分布與不確定度，而非只報最快一次。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use safe desktop replay to separate detection and action times, reporting distributions and uncertainty rather than only the fastest attempt.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。公式 y=v*reaction，代入得 y=40 m。邊界：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s. Formula y=v*reaction gives y=40 m. Boundary: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「道路使用者反應距離」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Road-user reaction distance", which statement holds?
options: 下游每分鐘放行車數穩定就能證明上游不會回堵
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致
原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。
optionsEn: Stable downstream vehicle discharge per minute proves that upstream spillback cannot occur.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 道路使用者反應距離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Road-user reaction distance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「道路使用者反應距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Road-user reaction distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以安全桌面重播分別量察覺與動作時間，呈現分布與不確定度，而非只報最快一次。以「道路使用者反應距離」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use safe desktop replay to separate detection and action times, reporting distributions and uncertainty rather than only the fastest attempt. For road-user reaction distance, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把假想反應時間 reaction 從 2.5 改成 2.75 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40 變為 44 m。先說明「道路使用者反應距離」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only assumed reaction time reaction from 2.5 to 2.75 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 40 to 44 m. Explain the causal direction for road-user reaction distance, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：事先告知事件時刻會使反應異常快速，視線遮蔽則可能讓訊號亮起到被察覺之間增加延誤。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Announcing event timing produces unusually fast responses; occlusion adds delay between signal activation and detection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以安全桌面重播分別量察覺與動作時間，呈現分布與不確定度，而非只報最快一次。以「道路使用者反應距離」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Use safe desktop replay to separate detection and action times, reporting distributions and uncertainty rather than only the fastest attempt. For road-user reaction distance, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把假想反應時間 reaction 從 2.5 改成 2.75 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40 變為 44 m。先說明「道路使用者反應距離」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only assumed reaction time reaction from 2.5 to 2.75 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 40 to 44 m. Explain the causal direction for road-user reaction distance, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「道路使用者反應距離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Road-user reaction distance"?
options: 以安全桌面重播分別量察覺與動作時間，呈現分布與不確定度，而非只報最快一次。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要安培小時數相同任何兩種電池續航就一定相同
optionsEn: Use safe desktop replay to separate detection and action times, reporting distributions and uncertainty rather than only the fastest attempt.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Equal ampere-hour ratings guarantee equal runtime for any two batteries.
quiz.explanation: 以安全桌面重播分別量察覺與動作時間，呈現分布與不確定度，而非只報最快一次。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use safe desktop replay to separate detection and action times, reporting distributions and uncertainty rather than only the fastest attempt. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 道路使用者反應距離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Road-user reaction distance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「道路使用者反應距離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Road-user reaction distance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 事先告知事件時刻會使反應異常快速，視線遮蔽則可能讓訊號亮起到被察覺之間增加延誤。回到「道路使用者反應距離」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Announcing event timing produces unusually fast responses; occlusion adds delay between signal activation and detection. Trace the input chain for road-user reaction distance. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「制動性能很好就可以完全忽略人員反應期間的距離」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Good braking performance allows reaction distance to be ignored completely." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 事先告知事件時刻會使反應異常快速，視線遮蔽則可能讓訊號亮起到被察覺之間增加延誤。回到「道路使用者反應距離」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Announcing event timing produces unusually fast responses; occlusion adds delay between signal activation and detection. Trace the input chain for road-user reaction distance. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 道路車輛停止距離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stopping distance of road vehicles: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「道路車輛停止距離」如何影響鐵路平交道警報聯動的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stopping distance of road vehicles” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway grade-crossing warning coordination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將道路車輛反應距離與制動距離分開計算，強調此練習不是實際平交道設計視距。停止距離由反應期間的等速前進與制動期間的動能消散相加。速度增加會同時增加兩項，而減速度只影響第二項；把控制命令發出時間當成制動力建立時間會漏掉一段距離。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「道路車輛停止距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate reaction and braking distances separately for a road vehicle, emphasizing that the exercise is not an actual crossing sight-distance design. Stopping distance combines constant-speed travel during response with kinetic-energy removal during braking. Speed changes both contributions, whereas deceleration changes only the second. A command timestamp is not the instant at which the full braking force becomes available. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stopping distance of road vehicles” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「道路車輛停止距離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 道路車輛停止距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stopping distance of road vehicles: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「道路車輛停止距離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stopping distance of road vehicles” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.

steps.instruction: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。以「道路車輛停止距離」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
